About the Project

A leading content creation & marketing platform for K-12 athletic departments, schools, and districts in the U.S., trusted by thousands of customers across all 50 states. One of the key products is interactive touchscreen displays that showcase a school’s awards, records, and history.


About the Role

As a Launch Specialist, you will be the first to welcome a newly signed school or athletic department to Touch and guide them through a smooth, high-quality launch. You’ll manage multiple customer accounts at different onboarding stages, collect required assets, confirm setup details, and build much of the initial Touch site yourself (pages, content, layouts) to ensure the display is accurate, visually polished, and ready for launch—then support a seamless handoff to Customer Success.


Requirements

- Ability to effectively manage multiple customer accounts, each at different stages of the onboarding journey;

- Growth mindset: you’re a lifelong learner who’s committed to continuous professional growth and development;

- Solutions-oriented with a strong sense of ownership; you can identify issues and take appropriate action;

- Hunger for a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve, change is standard, and flexibility is a must;

- Strong design sense with the ability to create clean, organized, and visually polished Touch sites;

- Excellent English fluency, including reading, writing, and verbal communication (C1/C2 proficiency preferred);

- Prior experience in a customer-facing role (1+ year) is a plus;

- Ability to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours and be in-office five days per week.


Responsibilities

- Welcome newly signed schools or athletic departments to Touch and guide customers through a smooth, high-quality launch;

- Manage a portfolio of partners in different stages of the onboarding journey; collect required assets and confirm setup details;

- Build much of the initial Touch site: structuring pages, organizing content, configuring layouts, and ensuring accuracy and completeness;

- Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to resolve questions, remove blockers, and keep launches moving forward on schedule;

- Manage a high volume of inbound and outbound emails, Zoom meetings, and calls; answer questions and set timelines;

- Log all activity in Salesforce and ensure a seamless handoff to the Customer Success team after a successful launch.


We offer

- Mentorship and career growth: Learn directly from experienced B2B SaaS leaders, with a clear path for professional development across a variety of roles in support, sales, and customer success;

- Ownership and impact: Take responsibility for real outcomes and see your work make a difference for thousands of organizations;

- Startup experience: Gain hands-on exposure to how a fast-growing SaaS company operates;

- International opportunity: Work from Brazil, with a global team, selling into the U.S. market;

- Time off includes ~13 standard, annual US holidays, 15 business days of PTO for the first year, 18 for year two, and 21 for every year after;

- In-office in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (five days per week).

title: Profissional Back End .Net/Aws - Sr
description:
Código da vaga: 55675


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei Profissional Back End .Net/Aws - SR, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Habilidades Principais:

  • Profissional com experiência em desenvolvimento back-end .Net com sólida vivência em ambientes escaláveis (milhões de transações/requisições mensais) e arquitetura baseada em microsserviços e mensageria (RabbitMQ ou Kafka).
  • Principais responsabilidades: Projetar, implementar e manter soluções distribuídas;
    desenvolver integraçõesassíncronas;
    otimizar infraestruturaem AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, etc.);
    e garantir performance,segurança e resiliência em sistemas de alta disponibilidade.
  • Requisitos obrigatórios: Experiência prática com AWS, RabbitMQ (ou mensageria similar), arquitetura de microsserviços, bancos relacionais (SQL Server, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB). Desejável experiência com CI/CD, Git e metodologias ágeis.
  • Diferenciais: Certificações AWS, conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes), vivência com outras clouds (Azure, GCP) e experiência comprovada com sistemas de alta performance e escalabilidade.


  • Modelo de trabalho:Vaga presencial na região de Botafogo – RJ.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde;
Plano Odontológico;
Seguro de Vida;
Vale Refeição;
Vale Alimentação;
Horário Flexível;
Atuação híbrida;
Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.Com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Advogado(A) Sênior - Energia (Foco Em Petróleo, Gás E Biocombustíveis)
description:
O Veirano Advogados está em busca de um(a) Advogado(a) Sênior para reforçar sua prática de Energia e Infraestrutura, com foco em petróleo, gás natural e biocombustíveis.

Reconhecido internacionalmente entre as principais práticas do mercado, o grupo atua de forma recorrente nas operações mais estratégicas e sofisticadas do setor, assessorando empresas líderes, investidores globais, fundos e instituições financeiras em projetos que moldam o futuro da energia no Brasil.


Por que esta oportunidade?

  • Atuação direta em transações de alta relevância e visibilidade, muitas delas inéditas no mercado;
  • Exposição contínua a clientes nacionais e internacionais de primeira linha;
  • Ambiente técnico altamente qualificado, com espaço real para autonomia, protagonismo e crescimento;
  • Prática integrada, combinando regulação, direito público e transações complexas em setores fortemente regulados;
  • Excelente ambiente de trabalho, com uma equipe comprometida, colaborativa e genuinamente apaixonada pela área.


O que você fará?

  • Atuar em projetos e transações relevantes nos setores de energia, petróleo, gás natural e biocombustíveis;
  • Atuar em processos administrativos e contencioso regulatório perante ANP, ANEEL e outros órgãos reguladores;

  • Participar de operações relevantes de M&A, joint ventures e projetos estruturados;
  • Elaborar e negociar contratos-chave do setor, como farm-out agreements , Joint Operating Agreements (JOAs) , contratos de prestação de serviços e instrumentos regulatórios;
  • Atuar no day-to-day de clientes estratégicos, com visão de negócio e foco em soluções jurídicas eficientes.


O perfil que buscamos:

  • Advogado(a) com 8 anos ou mais de experiência, com trajetória consistente em energia, petróleo e gás, infraestrutura ou setores regulados;
  • Formação sólidaem direito regulatório e administrativo, com atuação consultiva e negocial;
  • Vivência préviaem escritórios especializados, empresas, agências reguladoras ou fundos de investimento;
  • Experiência em M&A, projetos ou financiamentos estruturados será considerada um diferencial relevante;
  • Inglês fluente;
  • Perfil proativo, analítico, com excelente capacidade de redação e conforto para atuar em assuntos complexos e de alta exposição.


Diferenciais que valorizamos

  • LL.M. ou pós-graduação em Infraestrutura, Regulação, Energia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Interesse genuíno em atuar na fronteira regulatória e transacional do mercado de energia.



O que oferecemos de benefícios:

· Assistência médica;

Localização:

Sobre nós:

Somos mais de 600 colaboradores distribuídos em quatro cidades do Brasil: Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Porto Alegre e Brasília. Além disso, temos parcerias com outros escritórios no Brasil e ao redor do mundo. Desde 1972, criamos sólidos relacionamentos com empresas líderes em diversos segmentos, simplificando relações internacionais e abrindo caminhos para negócios no Brasil e do Brasil para o mundo.

title: Analista De Sustentabilidade (Exclusiva Para Pessoas Com Deficiência)
description:
Analista de Sustentabilidade Junior - Exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência


Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Apoiar aos processos de sustentabilidade, qualidade, meio ambiente e ações sociais, identificando oportunidades, reduzindo o risco legal e promovendo a melhoria contínua e contribuindo para a gestão de custos e para o desenvolvimento sustentável da companhia.


Principais atividades:

  • Apoiar processos de integração de novas marcas, mudanças de processos e sistemas. Acompanhar e apoiar a gestão de documentos da cia, garantindo que os documentos estejam padronizados com o sistema de gestão;
  • Auxiliar na parametrização dos dados do SE suíte de acordo com as necessidades da organização;
  • Acompanhar análises críticas de desempenho do sistema de gestão integrado
  • Disponibilizar treinamentos de integração de novos colaboradores, apresentando o sistema de gestão integrado;
  • Monitorar a eficácia dos processos de ações corretivas e preventivas e apoiar os responsáveis, garantindo que as ações sejam tomadas evitando a recorrência;
  • Organizar a programação e realizar as auditorias internas, através de convocações de auditores internos garantindo o cumprimento das normas;

  • Acompanhar e analisar o cumprimento das legislações ambientais aplicáveis aos processos de meio ambiente;
  • Avaliar junto com Facilites a geração de efluentes gerados e processos de gerenciamento de resíduos em todas as áreas do Grupo, atendendo as normas específicas;
  • Levantar, executar, analisar e disponibilizar dados estatísticos e indicadores de recursos naturais, resíduos, efluentes e outros temas relacionados à meio ambiente e qualidade;
  • Executar e acompanhar processos de Licenciamento Ambiental e projetos aplicáveis à meio ambiente em todo o Grupo;
  • Disseminar a cultura de Qualidade e Meio Ambiente entre as equipes e auxiliar na efetiva utilização pelas áreas da empresa das ferramentas da qualidade, incluindo softwares de gestão;
  • Direcionar as demandas aos Assistentes, Aprendizes e Estagiários;
  • Atender as solicitações que chegam para a Qualidade e Meio Ambiente no Geral


Buscamos alguém que apresente:

  • Superior Completo em Farmácia, Biomedicina, Biologia, Enfermagem, Engenharia, Administração ou Gestão da Qualidade;
  • Desejável pós graduação em Qualidade e cursos de auditor interno ou externo.
  • Pacote Office – intermediário
  • Legislação ambiental – básico,
  • Ferramentas e sistema da qualidade – básico,
  • Modelos de monitoramento de sustentabilidade – básico,

  • Experiência em sistema de gestão da qualidade em laboratório, clínica ou hospital acreditado.
  • Desejável experiência com certificações/acreditações e auditorias internas e externas.


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.

Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido

Carga Horária: 220 horas

title: Fiscal De Operação (Rio De Janeiro)
description:
A Cushman & Wakefield é uma empresa multinacional que atua no ramo imobiliário. Trabalhamos para sermos o provedor global preferencial de serviços imobiliários, oferecendo as soluções mais criativas e inovadoras de forma consistente, gerando valor significativo aos nossos clientes. Queremos aumentar ainda mais a diversidade das nossas pessoas, pois entendemos que essa é a chave para a inovação. Por isso, incentivamos que mulheres, pessoas da comunidade LGBTQIAPN+, indígenas, afrodescendentes, pessoas com deficiência, maiores de 50 anos se candidatem as nossas vagas. Celebramos a diversidade e o nosso compromisso é criar um ambiente inclusivo para todos os colaboradores.



Atribuições / Responsabilidades:


  • Realizar rondas durante todo o período, observando as condições de infraestrutura das dependências do site, por exemplo: sistema de ar condicionado, vazamentos e infiltrações, sistema de iluminação, check-list e OSs preventivas ou corretivas.
  • Identificar se os mantenedoras de manutenção ou serviços gerais estão cumprindo com as regras de segurança, cronograma e considerando as políticas internas do cliente quanto a horários, EPIS, acessos, ruídos, odores, entre outros, com o objetivo de garantir que os serviços sejam prestados em conformidade.
  • Relatar ao supervisor de manutenção atividades indevidas, ou em não conformidade, com as regras realizadas pelas mantenedores, para que a empresa seja notificada.
  • Realizar abertura de espaços e salas controladas conforme necessidade com prévia autorização de seu gestor.
  • Acompanhar a manutenção e obras de sistemas elétricos, prediais e de sistema de ar condicionado e refrigeração, verificando o cumprimento das regras e normas de segurança.
  • Gerenciar as atividades de obras das equipes mantenedoras, mantendo um controle de obras a serem realizadas, e verificando se está acontecendo de forma correta.
  • Elaborar procedimentos técnicos.
  • Receber obras e conferir com os orçamentos (medição).
  • Elaborar relatórios fotográficos.


Requisitos para esta posição:


  • Mínimo Requerido: Formação em ensino técnico de nível médio (Eletrotécnica, Eletroeletrônica, Refrigeração, Edificações e Mecatrônica, Eletromecânica).
  • Desejável: Superior em Engenharia ou Arquitetura.
  • Experiência: Ter atuado na área de facilities e de manutenção com interface com prestadores de serviços e com cliente.
  • Competências Técnicas: Mínimo Requerido: Conhecimento de sistema de OSs preventivas e corretivas, noções de segurança do trabalho;
    Leitura e interpretaçãode dados: Gráficos, tabelas e projetos;
    Desenvolvimento de estudos técnicos;
    Entendimento e conhecimento de normas técnicas vigentes;
    Elaboração de cronogramas e planos de manutenção relativos as áreas correlacionadas;
    Conhecimentos de civil / técnico de obras, elétrica e mecânica de ar condicionado.
  • Desejável: Conhecimento em Auto Cad;
    NR10, NR33 NR35.


Oferecemos:

- Assistência odontológica

- Seguro de vida

- Gympass

- Desconto em cursos e faculdades

description:

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Disponibilidadepara trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass);
seguro de vida;
cooperativa de crédito;
previdência privada;
reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties:

You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards.
  • Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability.
  • Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders.
  • Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality.
  • Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools.
  • Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly.
  • Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture.
  • Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals.
  • Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems.
  • Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
  • Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.


Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects.
  • Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.Js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability.
  • Quality & DevOps: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments.
  • Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing).
  • Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing).
  • Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.


Nice to have:

  • Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
  • Spanish proficiency.
  • IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
  • Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
  • Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.G., Kafka), and feature flag management.

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation .

title: Platform Engineer
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • Deep expertise in AWS , especially working with services like ECS , IAM , and supporting microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub , GitHub Actions , and CI/CD pipeline orchestration in production environments.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python , Bash , or configuration formats like YAML and JSON for automation.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms , ideally using frameworks like Backstage .
  • Strong understanding of Platform as a Service (PaaS) principles and creating self-service tools to streamline developer workflows.
  • Experience developing modular, reusable infrastructure templates to enable scalable and consistent resource provisioning.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills;

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Build and evolve the internal developer platform , enabling engineering teams to self-serve infrastructure and deployments efficiently.

  • Develop self-service tools and dashboards that reduce support tickets and empower development teams.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the platform by continuously implementing updates and integrating new cloud-native technologies.
  • Collaborate with security and compliance teams to integrate guardrails and standards into platform tooling.
  • Support internal adoption of Backstage or similar developer portal frameworks to centralize resources and documentation.
  • Drive initiatives to reduce manual operations and increase developer velocity through automation and platform reliability.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.


The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.


Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.


Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.


Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.


No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.


About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Job Description

Regional Sales Manager


Status: Exempt (salaried)

Department: Sales


Position Summary

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Regional Sales Manager to lead our sales initiatives and drive market growth. This role will be a key player in shaping our go-to-market strategy, building strong customer relationships, and translating market needs into tangible business results. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of the whole sales cycle and a proven track record of exceeding sales targets.


Core Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead our marketing and sales efforts to develop and communicate a deep understanding of our product portfolio and its applicability
  • Lead our market segmentation and promotion strategy, developing winning tactics for market development
  • Developing and maintaining our ideal customer profile aligned with market trends
  • Drive lead generation, prospecting new opportunities in the market to build a robust pipeline
  • Qualifying leads for sales contacts
  • Monitoring, Controlling and Reporting Sales Funnels
  • Drive meetings with prospects, understanding their needs, and translating them into project requirements
  • Communicating with our product, service, and spare parts teams to develop a winning value proposition and present a technical and commercial proposal to our customers
  • Following up proposals, handling objections and maximizing the value perception within our sales-qualified leads
  • Leading contract revisions and signatures (Including T&Cs)
  • Handling-off EPC, services and spare parts projects to our operations team


Education and Experience

  • 2+ years of Sales Management Experience in O&G Upstream market
  • Experience in complex topside FPSO engineering systems will be a differential
  • Engineering University degree
  • Fluently (written and speech) in Portuguese and Business-level English
  • Being able to work on companies-customized SAP application will be a differential
  • Strong negotiations skills and entrepreneurial behavior – ability to work independently.
  • Team player skills
  • Pro-active attitude
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Results-oriented and driven work style
  • Excellent task-oriented follow-through

title: Analista De Validação De Processo
description:
1. Planejar, coordenar e executar estudos de validação de processos de fabricação. Elaborar protocolos, relatórios e análises críticas para suportar a reprodutibilidade e consistência do processo.

2. Desenvolver e executar protocolos de validação de limpeza para assegurar a remoção eficaz de resíduos e evitar a contaminação cruzada. Determinar os limites de aceitação de acordo com os requisitos de boas práticas de fabricação (GMP).

3. Planejar e conduzir validações de filtração esterilizante, incluindo testes de integridade, adsorção e retenção bacteriana para garantir a eficácia dos filtros utilizados nos processos de esterilização.

4. Realizar estudos de tempo de espera (holding time) para determinar e validar os tempos máximos permitidos entre as etapas críticas de produção, garantindo a manutenção da qualidade e esterilidade dos produtos.

5. Elaborar, revisar e aprovar protocolos, relatórios de validação de envase asséptico e outros documentos técnicos. Garantir a integridade e a rastreabilidade de todos os registros, em conformidade com as exigências regulamentares e padrões internos.

6. Atuar como referência técnica em processos de validação durante auditorias internas e externas, incluindo inspeções de autoridades sanitárias e auditorias de clientes.

7. Participação ativa em investigações de desvios, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;

8. Elaborar apresentações e treinamentos referentes às atividades sob sua responsabilidade.

9. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de qualidade, produção, engenharia e desenvolvimento, para a implementação de melhorias contínuas nos processos validados e o suporte técnico necessário em projetos e mudanças.

10. Participação da elaboração de URS (User Requirements Specification) para definição de novos projetos ou alteração de projetos já existentes.

title: International Buyer
description:
General Description


The Buyer will be responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and assisting in the management of the inventory for the landing gear MRO operations. This role will require a high level of attention to detail, an understanding of the aerospace industry, and the ability to work effectively with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure timely delivery of materials, components, and parts for maintenance and repair services.


Detailed Description


Procurement of Materials & Parts:

  • Source and purchase materials, components, and parts required for landing gear MRO operations.
  • Evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost, lead times, and reliability.
  • Ensure all purchases meet the required specifications and are compliant with industry standards and regulations (e.G., FAA, EASA).


Inventory Management:

  • Assist in the maintenance of optimal inventory levels with warehouse team to support continuous MRO operations while minimizing excess stock and potential obsolescence.
  • Help warehouse team if necessary, in the tracking and monitoring of the stock usage, reordering materials and components as necessary.


Supplier Relationship Management:

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and vendors to ensure high-quality products and timely deliveries.
  • Negotiate pricing, terms, and conditions with suppliers to ensure competitive sourcing and cost savings.


Quality Assurance & Compliance:

  • Work closely with the quality control and engineering teams to ensure that all materials and parts purchased meet the required standards for safety and performance.
  • Monitor and address any quality issues, returns, or discrepancies with suppliers.


Data Entry & Reporting:

  • Maintain accurate records of all purchasing transactions, including purchase orders, invoices, and delivery schedules.
  • Prepare regular procurement reports to track spending, inventory levels, and supplier performance.


Collaboration & Cross-functional Support:

  • Collaborate with maintenance, engineering, and other departments to identify material needs and ensure procurement aligns with operational requirements.
  • Provide support to project teams by ensuring the timely availability of materials for scheduled landing gear maintenance projects.


Cost Control:

  • Monitor and control procurement costs to meet budget targets and contribute to cost-saving initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements and cost efficiencies in procurement activities.


Qualification Minimum Requirements


Work Experience:

At least 3-5 years of experience in procurement or purchasing, ideally in an aerospace, MRO, or manufacturing environment.

Knowledge of landing gear systems, aerospace components, and regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA) is a significant advantage


Educational:

Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field preferred.

Fluent/advanced English


Technical Skills:

Proficient in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, etc.).

Knowledge of inventory management systems and ERP tools is a plus. (Oracle and quantum)


Soft Skills:

Strong negotiation and communication skills.

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

title: Especialista De Modelagem Hidráulica Pleno
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

description:

You are a senior full stack engineer who enjoy owning features end-to-end, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, and shaping delivery processes rather than simply executing tasks.   • Participating in code reviews and contributing to continuous improvement of development practices.

  • Troubleshooting, debugging, and resolving issues in both development and production environments.
  • Acting as a trusted senior contributor, helping to scale processes, shape workflows, and ensure consistency, quality, and efficiency across projects.

you can identify issuesand take appropriate action;

- Prior experience in a customer-facing role (1+ year) is a plus;

collect required assetsand confirm setup details;

answer questions and set timelines;

description:
Job Title: Head of Sales (Sales Manager)

Department: Sales

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer

Location: Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Brazil

Employment Type: Full-Time, CLT ou PJ


Role Overview


We are looking for a hands-on, results-driven Head of Sales to lead and scale our commercial operations in Brazil. This is both a strategic and operational role, ideal for someone who can design sales strategies and execute them personally.

You will be working in a startup environment, not a corporate structure. This means high autonomy, fast decision-making, direct customer contact, and the flexibility to step outside your job title when needed. In addition to defining the sales strategy, you will be actively involved in prospecting, client visits, negotiations, and closing deals.

This role is critical to the company’s growth. You will have a direct impact on revenue generation, team building, and the development of scalable sales processes as the company expands.


Key Responsibilities


Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth
  • Develop, implement, and continuously optimize clear, measurable sales strategies
  • Define priorities by region, product, and customer segment
  • Actively drive revenue through calls, on-site visits, and negotiations
  • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities
  • Adapt strategies quickly based on real-world market feedback


Field Sales Execution
  • Personally visit clients and prospects when required
  • Open new accounts through cold outreach and door-to-door visits
  • Support and close strategic and high-value negotiations
  • Represent the company professionally in the field


Team Leadership & Coordination
  • Coordinate daily with internal sales reps, freelancers, and partners
  • Set targets, KPIs, and execution plans
  • Lead from the front with active selling and field presence
  • Train, motivate, and hold the team accountable for results


CRM, Processes & Reporting
  • Work in a structured manner with the CRM system (HubSpot is essential)
  • Monitor pipeline, conversion rates, ticket size, and individual performance
  • Report results, forecasts, and action plans to management
  • Ensure sales activities align with operational and logistical capacity


Startup & Operational Support
  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced startup with changing priorities
  • Understand core operational and logistical processes to support sales execution
  • Support operations when needed to remove bottlenecks
  • Collaborate closely with finance, operations, and marketing teams
  • Contribute to improving internal processes as the company scales


Requirements


Must-Have
  • Proven experience as a Head of Sales, Sales Manager, or senior B2B sales professional
  • Strong ability to build and execute sales strategies
  • Comfortable with frequent calling and door-to-door sales
  • Highly results-driven and accountable
  • Flexible mindset suited to a startup environment
  • Fluent Portuguese and good English skills
  • Solid CRM and pipeline management experience (HubSpot is essential )


Nice-to-Have
  • Experience in horeca, wholesale, FMCG, or food & beverage
  • Experience in early-stage or scaling companies


Compensation & Rewards
  • Competitive base salary
  • Strong performance-based bonus structure
  • Clear and direct link between results and compensation
  • Long-term growth opportunities as the company scales


Who This Role Is For

This role is for someone who:

  • Thrives in a startup environment
  • Is flexible, hands-on, and solution-oriented
  • Builds strategies and executes them personally
  • Is motivated by performance-based rewards
  • Takes full ownership of sales performance and outcomes

title: Tax Coordinator
description:
The Regional Tax Coordinator will support the global tax function with end‑to‑end ownership of multi‑jurisdiction tax compliance, controversy, and operational readiness. The role encompasses direct and indirect taxes, withholding tax and treaty management, transfer pricing oversight, and implementation of new global regimes such as Pillar Two.

The coordinator will drive strategic tax planning initiatives that optimize the effective tax rate and cash taxes while ensuring robust compliance, operational substance, and scalable controls and automation. This position partners closely with finance, controllership, treasury, legal, and business teams to support new transactions, products, and market entries and to proactively assess permanent establishment and nexus risks.


RESPONSABILITIES

i. Ensures timely and accurate tax compliance across all in‑scope jurisdictions, including corporate income taxes, indirect taxes such as VAT, GST, ICMS, and ISS, and withholding tax returns and information reporting.

ii. The role owns the global tax calendar and filing controls, establishing standard operating procedures and clear accountabilities to maintain a consistently high on time filing rate and audit readiness.

iii. Map tax opportunities and risks, proposing and implementing tax planning initiatives and corporate restructurings aimed at tax efficiency and reduction of the overall tax burden.

iv. Act in a consultative capacity with business areas, treasury, and controllership, providing support on tax-related matters and new transactions.

v. Monitor changes in local and international tax legislation and ensure the implementation of internal improvements to comply with new regulations.

vi. Lead internal and external tax audits and inspections with authorities in Brazil and other jurisdictions, managing controversy strategies and external advisors to achieve efficient, defensible outcomes.

vii. Analyze due diligence reports and provide support for strategic projects, such as the development of new products and M&A transactions.

viii. Develop and monitor robust internal controls to mitigate tax risks.

ix. Prepare reports and documentation to support senior management in tax-related matters.


QUALIFICATIONS

i. Bachelor’s degree in accounting, law or related area

ii. Minimum 8 years of experience, (Big 4 or public company experience preferred)

iii. Language: English, advanced / Spanish, desirable


REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

i. Strong knowledge of global tax laws, cross-border regulations, and transfer pricing principles.

ii. Proficiency with tax preparation software and ERP.

iii. Experience with Financial institutions is desirable


SOFT SKILLS

i. Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment

ii. Effective planning and priority setting

iii. Must be well organized and detail-oriented

iv. Teamwork

v. Clear and effective written and verbal communication

vi. Interpersonal and presentation skills

vii. Analytical skills

I. A Missão da Posição

O Especialista de Design (Lifestyle) é o responsável estratégico por traduzir conceitos e ideias criativas em produtos técnicos viáveis e desejáveis. Atuando como o braço técnico da área de Estilo, sua missão é transformar os direcionamentos estéticos em especificações precisas, garantindo que a identidade da marca de Athleisure seja preservada desde o desenho inicial até o produto acabado. Ele atua como uma referência técnica, assegurando que cada peça de vestuário combine inovação estética com rigor funcional e comercial.


II. Responsabilidades Principais

  • Tradução e Desenvolvimento Técnico: Converter conceitos criativos e temas propostos pelo Estilista em desenhos técnicos, modelagens e acabamentos detalhados para as coleções.
  • Pesquisa Aplicada de Materiais: Realizar pesquisas de materiais e referências de mercado para viabilizar tecnicamente as tendências e comportamentos de consumo identificados.
  • Acompanhamento de Prototipagem: Atuar em parceria direta com as áreas de Produto, Modelagem e Sourcing, acompanhando ajustes, amostras e validações técnicas até a aprovação final das peças.
  • Interface de Viabilidade: Trabalhar de forma integrada com Comercial, Marketing e Produção para garantir que a tradução do design respeite a viabilidade técnica e os objetivos de negócio.
  • Guardião da Consistência Criativa: Zelar pela qualidade técnica e consistência estética das coleções, garantindo que o produto final reflita fielmente a identidade visual da marca.
  • Ajuste de Performance: Utilizar feedbacks de mercado e análises de performance das coleções para aplicar melhorias técnicas contínuas no desenvolvimento de novos produtos.


III. Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada em design de produto ou posições técnicas em moda, com foco em sportswear ou athleisure.
  • Domínio Técnico Avançado: Profundo conhecimento em processos de desenvolvimento, construção de vestuário, materiais tecnológicos e leitura/execução de fichas técnicas detalhadas.
  • Vivência em Suprimentos: Experiência prática no acompanhamento de produção e relacionamento técnico com fornecedores.
  • Habilidades de Tradução Criativa: Capacidade de converter conceitos abstratos em soluções de design comerciais e funcionais com rigor estético.
  • Formação: Graduação em Moda, Design de Moda, Desenho Industrial ou áreas correlatas.


IV. Diferenciais

  • Experiência em traduzir coleções de alta escala e múltiplas entradas sazonais.
  • Vivência em marcas de moda lifestyle que exijam alto nível de detalhamento técnico.
  • Capacidade de atuar como referência técnica dentro do time de estilo para viabilização de novos produtos.
  • Conhecimento em análise de dados de performance de produto para otimização do design.

title: Cloud Architecture Consultant
description:
About You

You are a Cloud Architect who enjoys owning architectural decisions and designing secure, scalable, and compliant cloud solutions. You thrive in regulated environments and are comfortable balancing hands-on technical work with strategic thinking.   • Review and optimize existing AWS environments for performance, reliability, security, and cost-efficiency.
  • Document cloud architectures, technical decisions, and compliance-related considerations clearly and consistently.

title: Especialista Em Design De Calçados
description:
Especialista em Design de Calçados

Localização: Rio de Janeiro – RJ


I. A Missão da Posição

O Especialista de Design (Shoes) possui um perfil híbrido, sendo responsável por todo o ciclo do calçado: desde a concepção criativa e estética (estilista) até a tradução técnica e funcional do produto (designer)2. Sua missão é garantir o equilíbrio entre a identidade de moda athleisure e a viabilidade produtiva, atuando de forma estratégica para que cada modelo seja, simultaneamente, um objeto de desejo e uma solução técnica de alta performance. Ele atua como o elo central entre o conceito criativo e o produto acabado, servindo como referência técnica e estética para o time.


II. Responsabilidades Principais

  • Criação e Tradução de Design: Propor conceitos criativos, temas e cartelas de cores, traduzindo-os em desenhos técnicos e especificações detalhadas para a construção de calçados.
  • Pesquisa e Inovação em Materiais: Realizar pesquisas de tendências globais e comportamento do consumidor, focando na aplicação de materiais tecnológicos e tecidos sintéticos voltados para alta performance.
  • Desenvolvimento e Refinamento Técnico: Atuar diretamente com Sourcing e Fornecedores no desenvolvimento de fôrmas, solados e componentes, garantindo que a proposta estética original seja mantida durante o processo de prototipagem e provas de calce.
  • Interface Estratégica: Colaborar de forma integrada com as áreas de Produto, Comercial e Produção para assegurar que o design respeite a viabilidade técnica e as metas de margem do negócio.
  • Guardião da Identidade e Ergonomia: Garantir a consistência visual das linhas de calçados, zelando pela qualidade estética e pela ergonomia, assegurando que o produto final reflita o DNA da marca.
  • Análise de Evolução de Produto: Monitorar a performance de vendas e o feedback de mercado para retroalimentar o processo criativo com melhorias contínuas no mix de produtos.


III. Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada atuando no ciclo completo de calçados (estilo e design técnico) em marcas de moda, sportswear ou acessórios.
  • Domínio Técnico-Criativo: Profundo conhecimento em processos de fabricação, materiais têxteis/sintéticos e habilidade técnica para leitura e criação de fichas e componentes.
  • Vivência em Chão de Fábrica: Experiência prática no acompanhamento de produção e desenvolvimento junto a fornecedores.
  • Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de traduzir o conceito da marca em produtos funcionais, equilibrando olhar apurado com as necessidades comerciais do mercado.
  • Formação: Graduação em Design de Produto, Moda, Design de Moda ou áreas correlatas.


IV. Diferenciais

  • Experiência específica no desenvolvimento de sneakers ou calçados utilitários para o nicho Athleisure.

title: Network engineer commissioning specialist (bsc/rnc), oss and sites
description:
We are looking for a Wireless Specialist with solid experience in mobile networks, responsible for commissioning, integration, and validation of Controllers (BSC/RNC), as well as operation and management of OSS platforms and support for field activities related to telecommunications sites.
This professional will work directly throughout the deployment, expansion, and optimization cycle of the network, ensuring performance, availability, and compliance with the client’s technical requirements.
Responsibilities: (Must-have). Perform commissioning, integration, testing, and troubleshooting of 2 G/3 G/4 G/5 G, Controllers (BSC/RNC) and OSS. Execute configuration, expansion, and technical audit activities on OSS platforms.
Support and accompany field activities related to the activation of new sites, swaps, migrations, and network expansions.
Ensure correct implementation of parameters, scripts, and integration routines.
Monitor network KPIs and alarms, identifying and proactively resolving faults.
Prepare technical reports, action plans, and network documentation.
Work collaboratively with planning, O& M, and optimization teams to ensure network performance and stability.
Provide technical support during maintenance windows and critical activation processes including SWAPs.
Technical Requirements:
Proven experience with BSC and/or RNC Controllers (any vendor: ZTE, Ericsson, Nokia, Huawei).
Knowledge of OSS and network management tools.
Strong understanding of commissioning, integration, and troubleshooting processes for 2 G/3 G/4 G/5 G networks.
Solid knowledge of RF, parameters, handovers, features, and network architecture.
Ability to interpret logs, KPIs, and performance reports.
Experience with integration scripts (MML, CLI, or equivalent).
Desirable experience with O& M interfaces and network databases.
Knowledge of field processes: Survey, Swap, and site activation.
Desired Profile:
Analytical, organized, and strong problem-solving skills.
Clear and objective communication with clients and internal teams.
Ability to work under pressure and during critical maintenance windows.
Proactive and collaborative attitude.
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
Certifications or training related to mobile networks will be considered an advantage.

title: Senior full stack developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.
Job Duties:
You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process.
Key Responsibilities: Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards. Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability. Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery. Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders. Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality. Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools. Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly. Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture. Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals. Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems. Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.
Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field. Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects. Stack: Backend (Java, Python and. Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures. Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability. Quality & Dev Ops: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments. Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing). Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing).
Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.
Nice to have:
Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
Spanish proficiency.
Ia C (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.g., Kafka), and feature flag management.

title: International buyer
description:
General Description
The Buyer will be responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and assisting in the management of the inventory for the landing gear MRO operations. This role will require a high level of attention to detail, an understanding of the aerospace industry, and the ability to work effectively with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure timely delivery of materials, components, and parts for maintenance and repair services.
Detailed Description
Procurement of Materials & Parts:
Source and purchase materials, components, and parts required for landing gear MRO operations.
Evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost, lead times, and reliability.
Ensure all purchases meet the required specifications and are compliant with industry standards and regulations (e.g., FAA, EASA).
Inventory Management:
Assist in the maintenance of optimal inventory levels with warehouse team to support continuous MRO operations while minimizing excess stock and potential obsolescence.
Help warehouse team if necessary, in the tracking and monitoring of the stock usage, reordering materials and components as necessary.
Supplier Relationship Management:
Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and vendors to ensure high-quality products and timely deliveries.
Negotiate pricing, terms, and conditions with suppliers to ensure competitive sourcing and cost savings.
Quality Assurance & Compliance:
Work closely with the quality control and engineering teams to ensure that all materials and parts purchased meet the required standards for safety and performance.
Monitor and address any quality issues, returns, or discrepancies with suppliers.
Data Entry & Reporting:
Maintain accurate records of all purchasing transactions, including purchase orders, invoices, and delivery schedules.
Prepare regular procurement reports to track spending, inventory levels, and supplier performance.
Collaboration & Cross-functional Support:
Collaborate with maintenance, engineering, and other departments to identify material needs and ensure procurement aligns with operational requirements.
Provide support to project teams by ensuring the timely availability of materials for scheduled landing gear maintenance projects.
Cost Control:
Monitor and control procurement costs to meet budget targets and contribute to cost-saving initiatives.
Identify opportunities for process improvements and cost efficiencies in procurement activities.
Qualification Minimum Requirements
Work Experience:
At least 3-5 years of experience in procurement or purchasing, ideally in an aerospace, MRO, or manufacturing environment.
Knowledge of landing gear systems, aerospace components, and regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA) is a significant advantage
Educational:
Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field preferred.
Fluent/advanced English
Technical Skills:
Proficient in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, etc.).
Knowledge of inventory management systems and ERP tools is a plus. (Oracle and quantum)
Soft Skills:
Strong negotiation and communication skills.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

title: Analista de seguros júnior -vaga exclusiva para pcd
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. title: Platform engineer (aws)
description:
About you
You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) using tools like Terraform to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning. Hands-on experience with Git Hub , Git Hub Actions , and CI/CD pipeline orchestration in production environments. Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python , Bash , or configuration formats like YAML and JSON for automation. Experience building internal developer platforms , ideally using frameworks like Backstage . Strong understanding of Platform as a Service (Paa S) principles and creating self-service tools to streamline developer workflows. Experience developing modular, reusable infrastructure templates to enable scalable and consistent resource provisioning. Familiarity with automatic provisioning logic , such as conditional resource deployment based on developer inputs. Excellent communication and collaboration skills; fluent in English (advanced) .

Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Git Hub Actions , ensuring secure, automated delivery across services. Define and maintain Infrastructure as Code modules that enforce best practices and support multi-service deployments at scale. Create reusable infrastructure templates for provisioning environments like ECS , based on dynamic developer inputs. Automate resource provisioning workflows , including conditional logic and default resource allocation. Develop self-service tools and dashboards that reduce support tickets and empower development teams. Contribute to the evolution of the platform by continuously implementing updates and integrating new cloud-native technologies.
Collaborate with security and compliance teams to integrate guardrails and standards into platform tooling.
Support internal adoption of Backstage or similar developer portal frameworks to centralize resources and documentation. Drive initiatives to reduce manual operations and increase developer velocity through automation and platform reliability.

title: Business development specialist
description:
We are seeking an ambitious and results-driven Business Development Manager specialized in engineering services to join our team in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. This role is essential for expanding our footprint in the engineering sector, driving new client acquisition, and strengthening strategic partnerships across Brazil’s key industries such as oil & gas, infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, and construction.
You will focus on selling a range of engineering solutions including design, consulting, project management, EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction), technical staffing, and specialized engineering services. If you have a strong network in Brazil’s engineering ecosystem and a proven ability to win complex, high-value contracts, this is your opportunity to play a pivotal role in our growth in one of Latin America’s most dynamic markets.
Key Responsibilities
Identify and develop new business opportunities in the engineering services sector across Brazil, with a primary focus on Rio de Janeiro and surrounding regions.
Prospect and qualify leads through targeted outreach, industry events, referrals, and digital channels (Linked In, sector-specific networks).
Build and maintain long-term relationships with key decision-makers in oil & gas companies, infrastructure developers, industrial manufacturers, energy firms, and government-related entities.
Develop tailored proposals and solutions that address clients’ engineering challenges.
Lead the full sales cycle: from initial contact, needs assessment, and technical presentations to contract negotiation and deal closure.
Collaborate with engineering, delivery, and technical teams to ensure proposals are competitive and aligned with client requirements.
Track market trends, competitor activity, regulatory changes, and upcoming projects (e.g., via ANP, IBAMA, public tenders) to inform strategy.
Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets for engineering services contracts.
Represent the company at industry events, trade shows (e.g., Rio Oil & Gas, OTC Brazil), and professional associations in Rio and São Paulo.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Petroleum, or related) or Business Administration. MBA or postgraduate studies are a plus.
5+ years of experience in B2 B business development or sales within the engineering services sector (consulting, design, EPC, technical outsourcing, etc.). Proven track record of winning and closing high-value engineering contracts (ideally > R$1 M).
Strong existing network in Brazil’s engineering market, particularly in Rio de Janeiro (oil & gas, energy, infrastructure sectors highly desirable).
Fluency in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a bonus). Excellent presentation and negotiation skills.
Familiarity with public and private tender processes in Brazil
Proficiency in CRM tools
Ability to understand technical engineering requirements and translate them into commercial value propositions.
Self-starter with strong hunter mentality, capable of working independently in a target-driven environment.

Conhecimento básico dos componentes e funções dos sistemas de trem de pouso em aeronaves.
Familiaridade com práticas comuns de manutenção de trem de pouso, procedimentos de reparo e cronogramas de revisão.

Desenvolver habilidades na inserção e gerenciamento de grandes quantidades de dados técnicos, como solicitações de atendimento ao cliente, especificações de peças e relatórios de serviço.
Aprender a organizar e recuperar dados de forma eficiente para relatórios e análises.

Solução de problemas com problemas técnicos:
Desenvolver habilidades na identificação e análise de problemas técnicos relatados pelos clientes, como problemas com o desempenho do trem de pouso.
Aprender a coordenar com engenheiros e equipes técnicas para solucionar problemas e resolver problemas com eficiência.

title: Senior staff reservoir simulation engineer
description:
Position Summary
CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.
CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.
Essential Responsibilities
The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.
The successful candidate will:
Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.
The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.
Education
Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.
Knowledge & Skills
This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, Power Point).
All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Experience Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.
No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!
We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.
About Us
Innovators in Simulation Technology
CMG (TSX: CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

Experiência com softwares de prospecção, vendas e marketing automation (Pipedrive, RD Station);

A Petz tem como propósito criar valor e proporcionar a melhor experiência possível na relação entre o pet e o seu tutor. E, para que isso seja possível, temos como visão sermos reconhecidos mundialmente, até 2025, como o melhor ecossistema do segmento pet.

Com uma estratégia omnicanal e que integra não só os canais físicos e digitais, mas também os segmentos de produtos e serviços, somos uma plataforma de soluções completa para os animais de estimação.

Nossa proposta é oferecer aos nossos clientes uma experiência de compra e atendimento diferenciado em nossas lojas físicas, além de agilidade e conveniência em nossos canais digitais. Sim, queremos estar presentes em todos os momentos da vida dos nossos clientes, tutores e pets.

Contamos, também, com a maior rede de centros de estética do Brasil e, sob a marca Seres, com a mais abrangente rede de centros veterinários do país; além de, por meio do maior programa nacional de adoção de cães e gatos, o Adote Petz, fomentamos a criação da conexão emocional do tutor com o seu novo melhor amigo.

E ainda nem falamos dos produtos da marca Petz, que já são mais de 300 itens disponíveis em todas as nossas lojas, sendo líder de vendas nas 25 categorias de produtos ofertados. Com um faturamento que cresce mais de 40% ao ano, isso mostra o quanto somos fortes, inovadores e entregamos produtos de qualidade aos nossos clientes.

E, aos poucos, esse ecossistema vem se expandindo e se fortalecendo com a chegada de grandes marcas do segmento junto ao grupo Petz, dentre elas: Zee.Dog, Cansei de Ser Gato, Cão Cidadão e Petix. Legal né?

A estratégia de omnicanalidade nos trouxe até aqui, e assim nos tornamos líderes de mercado e também uma empresa que dobra de tamanho a cada dois anos. Mas somos incansáveis e sabemos que há muito a ser feito, para isso, estamos investindo em fortalecer ainda mais o nosso ecossistema de serviços, produtos e contratação de gente melhor que a gente para continuar alcançando voos ainda mais altos e resultados expressivos.

E você, quer fazer parte deste time de pessoas apaixonadas por pets? Trabalhar num ambiente descomplicado e acolhedor, no qual respeitamos uns aos outros? Onde reconhecemos seus esforços e premiamos resultados? E principalmente, encantamos nossos clientes e temos prazer em servir?

Se você respondeu sim para todas essas perguntas, então vem fazer parte do #EcossistemaPetz #SomosPetz.

Cada um de nossos resorts abriga uma dúzia de nacionalidades diferentes, não apenas entre nossos clientes, mas também entre nossos funcionários, o que nos dá a oportunidade de crescer por meio do contato com diversas culturas O compromisso diário do Club Med com o planeta se reflete nos diversos compromissos assumidos pelos nossos departamentos de Acomodação e Recepção, que esperamos estender à maioria dos nossos Resorts, como a redução do uso de plástico, a introdução de garrafas de vidro ou garrafas térmicas de alumínio, etc.
